specification.damping_scaling: Inverse segment length: rotational reference 3e-5 Nms/rad and axial reference 0.5 Ns/m at 5 mm; uncalibrated
specification.inertia_model: Lumped node masses from adjacent half-segments, isotropic nodal rotary inertia; clamped root half-segment mass omitted from moving system
specification.limit_note: Numerical protection only, not a proposed physical stroke stop
specification.boundary_conditions: Proximal position and first-segment orientation fixed; distal position soft-constrained, orientation free. No intermediate world-fixed nodes.

specification.collision_scope: Humerus and scapula only in this fixed-end bench; full anatomy and continuum surface need separate verification
